title: ROS 2 topic list works but topic echo prints nothing in Docker --net=host: Fast DDS shared memory, measured
excerpt: Two containers with --net=host: the topic is listed, the publisher matches, and 0 of 100 messages arrive. --ipc=host on both, a shared /dev/shm or FASTDDS_BUILTIN_TRANSPORTS=UDPv4 (even on Humble, even on one side) each gave 100 of 100. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
